meta.name: Fittest On Earth Final Showdown In Madtown
meta.description: Athletes compete for the title Fittest on Earth experiencing exhilarating highs and devastating lows. This film amplifies the connection between each competitor's intense, personal journey, and their breathtaking feats of pure athleticism.
meta.slogan: A diverse cohort of elite athletes compete for the ultimate title of “Fittest on Earth” at the 2023 CrossFit Games.
